snippet.title: untitled doom project (WIP)
snippet.description:
coming off of the huge workload of the last album i wanted to do something very much not in my wheelhouse to exercise my brain a bit (I LOVE LEARNING TO DO THINGS........... ITS GOOD), so i decided to finally really dig into doom mapping. the the only other map i've ever actually finished was made in 2014, so over the past 2-3 weeks i've mostly been learning doom mapping (both BOOM and UDMF compatible), ACS scripting, DECORATE/ZSCRIPT from zero and it's been wicked fun! my only previous mapping experience was a bunch of BUILD (duke3d specifically) when i was younger. the maps in the game so far exist in the order i created them, so they start a little jank and get pretty complex pretty quickly. at least, geometrically complex.

here's some of the current project i'm working on. i'm up to map06 and there's much to be done yet! most textures are OTEX and Ancient Aliens (+some other stray ones from other games, full credits will be with release). a bunch of the enemies will look familiar to anybody that's seen the Realm667 offerings, but for the most part i've rescripted them all from the ground up with new bullet patterns and have replaced them and every other projectile with bright, highly readable bullets with a consistent color scheme. there are a couple custom weapons coming along as well. still have to sort out their balance, though. this has more or less become a "partial conversion" by accident. it also features new original music, of course! in both Impulse Tracker and MIDI formats, and you can choose which format you like from the menu!

this was going to be a BOOM-compatible project beacuse i'm a bit of a stickler for "vanilla feel" but once i started learning fun stuff i couldn't go back! no 3D floors or slopes though, any and all bridges/etc are old doom mapping tricks since i love that kind of stuff to death. i think whatever i do for DOOM after this will be BOOM-compatible. for now, though, the overall "feel" of this one seems to be hexen's map tech meeting doom psx/64's colored lighting. it feels weird to go too far beyond "DOOM" right now...

i think just about anybody could get into this, it's really accessible, there's a ton of information on places like the zdoom wiki, and the mapping community itself is just *the* nicest people. Insane_Gazebo, Bridgeburner, (both of whom are *insane* mappers) and uriko (and a number of others!) have all stopped by my work stream randomly and been helpful and encouraging. DOOM mapping seems to mean a lot to many people, and that's a really lovely thing.

hoping to have a few maps of this avialable soon for feedback so i can balance the difficulties more for folks among other things! would just like to wrap up map06 and get some other graphic/sound stuff done n_n

lots of love! hope you're all staying well.

no copyright intended
